nom: TATCHA Luminous Dewy Skin Mist 2-in-1 Hydrator & Finishing Spray

segments.dry: Reviewers describing dry skin, including one 66-year-old, report that this mist gives a refreshed, less dry look under makeup and works well as a routine finisher.
segments.mature: A reviewer with 66-year-old skin reports that makeup used to look dry on her and that this mist made a real difference.

concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers use this specifically for extra hydration or refreshment during the day and describe skin as feeling refreshed, hydrated and glowy; one reviewer disagrees, saying it doesn't seem to do anything on top of a moisturizer.

aspects.libelle: Bottle empties or seems underfilled quickly

extraits.texte: I do not understand the hype: I get the same result with a $5.00 mister. No noticeable difference as far as a setting. Nicely packaged but it's just water with a faint fragrance

Overall not a bad product, just not worth the price tag in my opinion. I bought this based on mostly glowing reviews and because I love the Tatcha dewy moisturizer, but this product did not meet my expectations. It's extremely lightweight and is truly a mist, which I like, but I just feel like it doesn't really do anything. If you're moisturizing your skin before applying, there really is no real difference with or without this product. In the summer it is hot here, so I try to not use full coverage makeup and more or less just do skincare makeup, and was really hoping this would be a staple in bag. Not a bad product, I just wouldn't repurchase again.

extraits.titre: Do they even fill the bottle??
extraits.texte: I purchased this about a month ago and overall really like the product. My problem with it is that either the bottle wasn't full when I bought it or it gets used up really, really fast.

I used to think, who needs a finishing spray. Apparently I do! My 66 year old skin can look dry with makeup on and this REALLY made a difference. Try it out in the store first, that is what sold me right then and there!

I'm not sponsored, I just tried it and genuinely love this. I use it every morning, even without makeup, and it makes my skin feel refreshed, hydrated, and just overall wonderful. At night before bed, I spray it again and I'm completely obsessed. My skin just drinks it up and looks healthy and glowy. I didn't expect to love it this much, but I really do!

extraits.titre: One of My Skincare Must Haves!
extraits.texte: As someone whose skin is on the dry side, I love using this as a "finisher" to my skincare routine. Makes my skin feel very refreshed

reserve: Only 12 reviews are available and few state skin type explicitly, so segment-level conclusions beyond dry/mature skin are limited.
